messages:
Marta (Sales): Quick handoff — StoneQuarry Labs closed late. Contacts: Elena (CTO), Samir (Infra). They requested private VPC peering + Okta SCIM, dedicated capacity starting ~4 weeks. Baseline ~2.4M tokens/mo, bursts ~4.6M. Procurement moves slowly; recommend renewal-watch if PO > 30 days. Passing to CS for onboarding and Eng/Support for infra/runbook prep.

Diego (CS): Taking point. I will schedule a 30m technical kickoff with Elena/Samir. Need billing contact, priority flows (chat vs batch embeddings vs webhooks), and any compliance notes.

Marta (Sales): Billing contact is Felix (Finance) cc'd. Priority flows: 1) short-chat agent (low-latency) 2) nightly embeddings 3) realtime webhook classification. Sample prompts & evals: https://drive.redwood/stoneq-examples. Model: redwood/opt-13b-quant, checkpoint ~11.5GB post-quant. Seq len chat ~512, batch up to 2048.

Liu (Eng): I can own VPC/peering + SSO precheck. ETA: 3 business days for an initial checklist. Need test CIDR, egress rules, and infra contact for Terraform state. Ill include GPU sizing and a recommended canary ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%).

Rae (Support): Ill draft the support/runbook and onboarding playbook. Starter checklist:
```
preflight:
  - validate peering & routing
  - SCIM user sync test
monitoring:
  - p95 latency target <350ms
  - 5xx <0.5%
escalation:
  - cs-oncall -> eng-oncall -> infra
```
Will share v1 by EOD Fri. Also recommend a joint runbook drill with their oncall in week 2.

Felix (Finance): Procurement noted SOC2 + DPA. PO ETA currently ~3 weeks but could extend. Ill prioritize and update here; will tag renewal-risk if PO not received in 30 days.

invite-bot: Kickoff event created: Thu 11:00am PT "StoneQuarry technical kickoff" (invitees: Marta, Diego, Liu, Rae, Elena).

Diego (CS): Proposed owners & deadlines for kickoff doc: Diego (CS lead) - kickoff & success criteria (by Thu), Liu (Eng) - infra precheck (3bd), Rae (Support) - runbook draft (by Fri), Felix (Finance) - PO follow-up. Risks: procurement/SOC2 -> renewal-watch if PO >30d. Please drop any sample failure cases during kickoff so we can wire quality monitors.

Marta (Sales): Added concurrency/throughput numbers to the doc and a note about a possible 24/7 support add-on. If procurement slips Ill escalate to AM.

Liu (Eng): Noted. Ill include GPU-hour estimates and fallback model policy (hosted compat) in case dedicated capacity delayed.

Rae (Support): Ill add an "what to log" snippet (trace_id, request_id, model_id, latency_ms) to the doc to speed triage.

Diego (CS): Thanks team — Ill update this thread after the kickoff with owners & final runbook link. Closing loop for now :thumbsup:
